problem:
$$
P=[\begin{aligned}\frac{4}{\sqrt{17}} & -\frac{1}{\sqrt{17}} \\ \frac{1}{\sqrt{17}} & \frac{4}{\sqrt{17}}\end{aligned}],\,Q=[\begin{aligned}2\sqrt{7} & \sqrt{5} \\ 4\sqrt{5} & 5\sqrt{7}\end{aligned}]
$$

Find $|\text{det}(PQ)|$ given that $P$ is an orthogonal matrix.
worked_solution:
We use the following facts: 

- The determinant of a product is equal to the product of the determinants.

- The determinant of an orthogonal matrix $P$ is equal to $\pm 1.$

Applying these ideas, we get the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}|\text{det}(PQ)| & =|\text{det}(P)\cdot \text{det}(Q)| \\  & =|(\pm 1)\cdot \text{det}(Q)| \\  & =|\pm 1|\cdot |\text{det}(Q)| \\  & =|\text{det}(Q)| \\  & =|2\sqrt{7}\cdot 5\sqrt{7}-\sqrt{5}\cdot 4\sqrt{5}| \\  & =50\end{aligned}
$$
